ModMetaData.name: Transcendence: Skills Beyond 20
ModMetaData.author: metelikadam
ModMetaData.description:
Legendary is no longer the end of the road.
Transcendence raises the skill cap from 20 to 40. Levels 0-20 behave exactly like vanilla. Levels 21-40 - the Transcendent levels - can only be earned through XP: each one costs much more than the last, but gives a much bigger bonus to every skill-based stat and to crafted item quality.
Features: - Skill cap 40, with vanilla untouched below 20 - Steep XP curve above 20 (about 1.9 million XP from 20 to 40 by default) - Bigger per-level bonuses above 20 for every skill-based stat, including DLC and modded stats - Work bills allow skill levels up to 40 - Configurable XP difficulty and effect strength in Mod Settings
Compatibility: - Vanilla Skills Expanded: passion forget rates apply above 20, and every skill earns expertise slots at levels 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 - Mad Skills+: decay is handled by Mad Skills+ with no double decay - Vanilla Expanded Framework: gene forget multipliers apply above 20
Requires Harmony.
